These are drawings 1-4 of ONE roughly two-second stroke, chronological left to right:
1: Dairon reaches well forward with straight leading arm and forward-inclined torso, blade just touches water. Blue paddler is already midway through pull, shoulders turned. Plum paddler has blade leaving water. Yara leans slightly back to balance holding bundle. Amaia braces sleeping child.

3: Dairon begins pulling, shoulders rotate, elbows begin flexing, pelvis stays seated. Blue paddler finishes pull and leans back. Plum paddler swings recovering paddle forward. Hair/cloth lag distinctly behind torsos.
4: Dairon pulls strongly toward hip with clear whole-torso rotation and changed bent arms. Blue paddler lifts blade; plum paddler reaches to plant. Yara turns shoulders subtly against boat roll, Beheto exhales over drum, children balance with hands braced. Water fans from strokes and wakes trail to LEFT.
Each drawing advances motion by a small coherent amount, like traditional anime in-betweens. Full scene always visible. Background trees and moon shift only very slightly left consistently with tracking, no rearranged forest. Same textured ink/cel-painted anime finish as reference. No speed lines, magical glow, extra props, dialogue or dramatic lighting changes. Avoid isolated patch motion or repeated still frames.
